privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We collect only the data required to respond and support your request.
privacy.body1: Form fields are assembled in your browser to open a WhatsApp message. The website does not submit these fields to a contact API or store their contents in a database. Delivery takes place when you confirm the message in WhatsApp, subject to that service's policies.
privacy.body2: We use details received by WhatsApp or email to respond and prepare proposals. The website stores language and appearance preferences in your browser; the hosting provider may process technical access logs. To request information, updates or deletion of details shared with us, use our contact email.
